title: Study Path: Well-rounded IT & CS
oneLiner: A week-by-week route through the whole academy for broad, practical computing knowledge: hardware, programming, operating systems, networks, security, Linux, databases, Git, systems and AI.
keyTakeaway: Breadth first, in the order things build on each other: how computers work, then programming, then the operating system your code runs on, then the networks it talks over and how to secure them, then data, tools and larger systems. A little every week beats a lot once, and the quizzes inside each lesson are the real test of whether it stuck.
explanation:
Conperio Academy covers a lot, and it's hard to know where to start if you aren't preparing for a particular interview. This path is for anyone in IT, automation or software who wants a solid all-round foundation: the kind of knowledge that makes a networking problem, a security review, a database question or a conversation about AI easy to follow.

It runs in five phases. How computers work covers the math, data types, hardware, logic gates and number systems. Programming teaches C# and Python side by side with graded exercises, plus a first look at algorithms and Big O. Operating systems covers scheduling, system calls, processes, threads and memory, then real Linux in the browser (and Windows and PowerShell as those lessons arrive). Networks and security runs from how the internet fits together through subnetting, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs and troubleshooting, then passwords, phishing, web attacks, threat modeling, incident response and plant network security. Data, tools and systems finishes with SQL, Git and testing, cloud and containers, system design basics and AI.

Pick how many weeks you want to spread it over; the material is the same either way. Graded exercises tick themselves when you pass them, and explainer lessons count once you mark them worked through. The progress tab shows coverage by topic and suggests what to do next. The same tool also holds the FAANG interview plan; switch between them at the top. Your plan is saved in this browser.
